message.text:
q05.

**8** services: `AIService`, `AttachmentService`, `AuthService`, `IdentityProviderService`, `InstanceService`, `MemoService`, `ShortcutService`, `UserService`.

Each is declared in its own `.proto` file under `proto/api/v1/`:

| Service | File |
|---|---|
| `AIService` | `proto/api/v1/ai_service.proto` |
| `AttachmentService` | `proto/api/v1/attachment_service.proto` |
| `AuthService` | `proto/api/v1/auth_service.proto` |
| `IdentityProviderService` | `proto/api/v1/idp_service.proto` |
| `InstanceService` | `proto/api/v1/instance_service.proto` |
| `MemoService` | `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` |
| `ShortcutService` | `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto` |
| `UserService` | `proto/api/v1/user_service.proto` |

Note that `IdentityProviderService` is the one case where the service name doesn't match its filename (`idp_service.proto`). The directory holds ten `.proto` files total, but `common.proto` and `README.md` declare no services — `common.proto` only carries shared message types.

The generated output confirms the same count: `proto/gen/api/v1/` contains exactly eight `*_grpc.pb.go` files and eight `*.connect.go` files, one per service, so all eight are exposed over both gRPC and Connect.
